name: Hiasler Hof
beschreibung: The Hiasler Hof welcomes visitors to a sunny, peaceful rural setting in Kössen in the Kaiserwinkl holiday region in the Kitzbühel Alps. This traditionally managed farmhouse offers cosy guest rooms styled with native timber, complete with en-suite bathrooms (shower/WC), satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies framing open views of the Kaisergebirge and the Kitzbühel Alps. In the morning, a rich breakfast buffet filled with farm-fresh dairy and regional delicacies awaits guests. The valley station of the Kössen cable cars at the Unterberg, as well as the renowned Kaiserwinkl cross-country skiing trail network, are only minutes away. In summer, nearby Lake Walchsee invites swimming and water sports, alongside scenic alpine hikes.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional farm guesthouse in Kössen in the Kaiserwinkl featuring cosy rooms, breakfast buffet, and close to the Unterberg.
